title: Taipei vs Hong Kong: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Taipei for value, night markets, and natural escapes. Hong Kong for skyline drama, dim sum, and English ease. Do both if you have 10+ days.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Taipei wins on value — NT street food vs HK+ dim sum. Both are world-class; different cuisines.

categories.name: Skyline & Sights
categories.summary: Victoria Harbour is one of the world's great urban vistas. Taipei 101 is impressive but not in the same category.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Taipei is 30–40% cheaper overall across food, accommodation, and activities.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Both have excellent metro systems. Hong Kong has more charm (Star Ferry, trams). Taipei has YouBike.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Jiufen, Taroko Gorge, Yangmingshan vs Macau, Lantau. Taipei has richer nature access.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: HK wins on international club culture; Taipei wins on affordability and night market scene.

categories.name: English
categories.summary: HK is bilingual official. Taipei has decent tourist English but noticeably less.

categories.name: Best Time
categories.summary: Both peak Oct–Dec. Avoid Taipei spring (rain) and HK summer (typhoons).

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Both rank among Asia's safest cities.

faq.question: Is Taipei or Hong Kong better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Taipei for value and warmth; Hong Kong for drama and skyline. Budget travelers: Taipei. Short trip seekers: Hong Kong.

faq.question: Which is cheaper?
faq.answer: Taipei, by about 30–40%. Mid-range daily: ~–94 in Taipei vs ~–205 in Hong Kong.
